entries.title: Job 40:1
segments: And the LORD answered Job and said,

entries.title: Job 40:2
segments: Shall a reprover contend with the Almighty? He who reproves God, let him answer it.

entries.title: Job 40:3
segments: And Job answered the LORD and said,

entries.title: Job 40:4
segments: Behold, I am vile! What shall I answer You? I will lay my hand on my mouth.

entries.title: Job 40:5
segments: Once I have spoken; but I will not answer; yea, twice, but I will go no further.

entries.title: Job 40:6
segments: And the LORD answered Job out of the tempest, and said,

entries.title: Job 40:7
segments: Now gird up your loins like a man. I will question you, and you teach Me.

entries.title: Job 40:8
segments: Will you also set aside My judgment? Will you condemn Me so that you may be justified?

entries.title: Job 40:9
segments: And [have] you an arm like God? Or can you thunder with a voice like His?

entries.title: Job 40:10
segments: Adorn yourself now with majesty and grandeur, and with glory and honor clothe yourself.

entries.title: Job 40:11
segments: Pour forth the rage of your wrath; and behold everyone who is proud, and abase him.

entries.title: Job 40:12
segments: Look on everyone [who is] proud, [and] bring him low; and tread down the wicked in their place.

entries.title: Job 40:13
segments: Hide them in the dust together; [and] bind their faces in darkness.

entries.title: Job 40:14
segments: Then I also will confess to you that your own right [hand] can save you.

entries.title: Job 40:15
segments: Now behold behemoth, which I made along with you; he eats grass like an ox;

entries.title: Job 40:16
segments: see, now, his strength [is] in his loins, and his force [is] in the muscles of his belly.

entries.title: Job 40:17
segments: He hangs his tail like a cedar; the sinews of his thighs are knit together.

entries.title: Job 40:18
segments: His bones [are] like tubes of bronze; his bones [are] like bars of iron.

entries.title: Job 40:19
segments: He [is] the first of the ways of God; his Maker brings near his sword.

entries.title: Job 40:20
segments: For the mountains yield food for him, and all the beasts of the field play there.

entries.title: Job 40:21
segments: He lies under the lotus, in the hiding place of the reed and the marsh.

entries.title: Job 40:22
segments: The lotus trees cover him [with] their shadow; the willows of the brook surround him.

entries.title: Job 40:23
segments: Behold, though a flood presses, he does not run away; he feels safe even if Jordan swells up to his mouth.

entries.title: Job 40:24
segments: Shall [any] take him before [his] eyes, or pierce through [his] nose with cords?
